definition: A financial guardian, also referred to as a guardian of the estate, is a person who is lawfully entrusted with the responsibility of taking care of the property of someone who is unable to do so because of infancy, incapacity, or disability. The guardian has the duty to take reasonable care of the property and use it in the most beneficial manner.
